items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: we had a little group known as the Chocolate Drops or something, the Four Chocolate Drops, and that group was Dootsie Williams... and myself

ctx.x: Well, we -- that's on the part of the tape we had to do over, and we haven't mentioned it today, so tell me about the Club Royal.

Well, the Club Royal, and this goes back to of course before recording, before I made records. I had worked -- before this I think I had worked with Dootsie Williams, who was a -- we had a little group known as the Chocolate Drops or something, the Four Chocolate Drops, and that group was Dootsie Williams, who now owns Dooto [Records], and myself, George Reed, who's still around, a fine vocalist and drummer who never really got big. He used to work with Horace Henderson also. George never really made it big, but…
Dootsie Williams. So in that group we worked in -- I don't know if I -- I thought I mentioned about us coming home in the blackout. Wasn't that on that first tape?
